senses.gloss: (Pilp. of בוט or בטט, v. בטי) to swell.—Hithpa. הִתְבַּטְבֵּט; Nithpa. נִתְבַּטְבֵּט to swell, grow. Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 9">Mishp. 9</cite> as the bite of a snake is not felt <he>עד שנ׳ עליו</he> until a swelling sets in, so is usury not felt <he>עד שמִתְבַּטְבֶּטֶת עליו</he> until it has grown upon him (the debtor).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31">Ex. R. s. 31</cite> <he>שמתבעט</he>, corr. acc.).
